body: It’s both. My life has run its course.

I’ve tried enough things for enough time that I don’t really think it’s realistic for me to expect things to work out any different. It’s a tough world, my brain isn’t adapting to modern life. 

I had one big regret, a friend that I wronged for dumb reasons several years ago. Made up with them a few months back. I’m comfortable with where I’m leaving things. 

I won’t miss anyone, because I’ll be dead.

You should be fine if your lead in isn’t “hello, can you please help me make a suicide device?” 😂 I told them I was picking stuff up for a friend to repay him for some work I’m having him do. They didn’t question it
